topic: Variables: The Labeled Box Metaphor
concept: Think of a variable as a labeled storage box that holds a value with a simple name.
metaphor: A shoe box with a sticky note labeled 'age' containing the number 25.
cta: Follow for Lesson 2 where we explore Numbers and Words!

topic: Numbers vs Words: Integers, Floats, and Strings
concept: Computers treat whole numbers, decimals, and words completely differently.
metaphor: You can do math with coins (numbers), but words (strings) must stay wrapped in quotes.
cta: In Lesson 3, we teach Python how to make decisions using True and False!

topic: Booleans: The Power of True and False
concept: A boolean is a simple light switch: it is either ON (True) or OFF (False).
metaphor: Is the door locked? Yes (True) or No (False). That's all a boolean is.
cta: Next in Lesson 4: Using Booleans in If-Else statements!

topic: If-Else: Teaching Code to Make Decisions
concept: If-Else branches let your program take different paths depending on a condition.
metaphor: If it's raining, bring an umbrella. Else, wear sunglasses.
cta: In Lesson 5, we stop repeating code using While Loops!

topic: While Loops: Repeat Until Done
concept: A while loop keeps running its code block as long as its condition remains True.
metaphor: Keep drinking water while your water bottle is not empty.
cta: Lesson 6 introduces For Loops and Lists — the most popular loop in Python!

topic: Lists & For Loops: Iterating Over Items
concept: A list is a grocery shopping list, and a for loop visits every item one by one.
metaphor: Taking each fruit out of your grocery bag and placing it on the table.
cta: In Lesson 7, we organize data using Dictionaries!

topic: Dictionaries: Real-World Key-Value Pairs
concept: Dictionaries connect a unique label (key) to its information (value).
metaphor: Looking up a contact in your phone: Name is the key, Phone Number is the value.
cta: In Lesson 8, we build reusable recipe blocks called Functions!

topic: Functions: Building Your Own Reusable Recipes
concept: A function is a named mini-recipe that you write once and run whenever you want.
metaphor: A microwave button preset: press 'Popcorn' and it does the entire sequence.
cta: Lesson 9 covers the crucial difference between Print and Return!

topic: Print vs Return: Giving Results Back
concept: Print shows text on the screen, but Return hands data back so your code can use it.
metaphor: Print is reading a score out loud; Return is writing the score on your report card.
cta: Season 1 Finale in Lesson 10: Building a complete Mini Calculator!

topic: Season 1 Finale: Building a Mini Calculator
concept: Combining Variables, If-Else, and Functions into a working interactive program.
metaphor: Putting together all the Lego bricks we mastered in Lessons 1 through 9.

topic: JavaScript Variables: let vs const vs Python
concept: In JS, we use 'let' for variables that change, and 'const' for values that stay locked.
metaphor: A pencil-written note (let) vs an engraved plaque (const).
cta: Follow for Lesson 12: JavaScript Template Literals vs Python F-Strings!

topic: Template Literals: Backticks and ${} in JS
concept: Instead of f-strings, JavaScript uses backticks and dollar-curly-braces for text.
metaphor: Filling in the blanks on a form letter.
cta: In Lesson 13, why JavaScript has triple equals (===)!

topic: Why JavaScript has === (Strict vs Loose Equality)
concept: Double equals tries to guess types; triple equals checks both the value and the exact type.
metaphor: A counterfeit detector: === checks the watermark and the serial number.
cta: In Lesson 14, we explore JavaScript Arrays and .push()!

topic: JavaScript Arrays: push, pop, and index access
concept: Arrays in JavaScript work just like Python lists, but use .push() instead of .append().
metaphor: Adding another tray to a stack of trays.
cta: In Lesson 15: For loops and the for...of syntax in JS!

topic: For...of Loops: Clean Iteration in JavaScript
concept: The for...of loop in JS gives you the clean simplicity of Python's for loop.
metaphor: Stepping through each song on your playlist.
cta: In Lesson 16, we compare While loops in JS and Python!

topic: While Loops in JavaScript
concept: While loops in JS use parentheses and curly braces around their block.
metaphor: Pumping gas into your car until the tank sensor clicks.
cta: Lesson 17 introduces JavaScript Objects!

topic: JavaScript Objects: Key-Values with Dot Notation
concept: JS Objects let you access properties using dot notation like user.name!
metaphor: An ID card with Photo, Name, and Role clearly printed.
cta: In Lesson 18, we learn modern Arrow Functions!

topic: Arrow Functions: Concise Modern JS Syntax
concept: Arrow functions () => {} are the modern, clean way to write functions in JavaScript.
metaphor: A shortcut key on your keyboard.
cta: Lesson 19 covers Scope and how variables hide inside functions!

topic: Scope: Why Variables Stay Inside Functions
concept: Variables created inside a function are private to that function and cannot leak out.
metaphor: Secrets discussed in a conference room stay inside that conference room.
cta: Season 2 Finale in Lesson 20: Building an interactive JS click counter!

topic: Season 2 Finale: Building a Click Counter in JS
concept: Combining variables, arrow functions, and state updates in JavaScript.
metaphor: A digital tally counter on your wrist.

topic: Java Types: Why Java Demands Exact Types
concept: In Java, every variable must announce its exact type before running.
metaphor: Custom fitted slots in a toolbox: only a wrench fits in the wrench slot.

topic: Printing & Methods: System.out.println in Java
concept: How Java structures code into classes and methods.
metaphor: A blueprint folder containing certified instruction sheets.

metaphor: A security gate that strictly requires a verified badge.

topic: Java For Loops: Index Tracking (int i = 0)
concept: The classic 3-part for loop: start, condition, and step counter.
metaphor: A lap counter clicking at every lap around the track.

concept: Java arrays have a fixed length set at creation that cannot grow.

topic: Java ArrayList: Growing Lists on Demand
concept: ArrayList is Java's dynamic list that automatically expands as you add items.
metaphor: An accordion folder that stretches as you add documents.

concept: Iterating over collections cleanly without managing index variables.
metaphor: Browsing books on a library shelf one by one.

topic: Java HashMap: Fast Key-Value Lookups
concept: HashMap connects keys to values with instant lookup speed.
metaphor: A coat check room where your claim ticket retrieves your exact jacket.

topic: Classes & Objects in Java: Creating Blueprints
concept: A Class is a cookie cutter; an Object is the actual cookie created from it.
